blocks.text: Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) aisa paudha, janwar ya microbe (jarsooma) hai jis ka genome (kul genetic maadda) badal diya gaya ho. Transgenic organisms GMOs ka aik khaas hissa (subset) hain: yeh woh GMOs hain jinhein kisi mukhtalif, ghair mutaliq (unrelated) species ka DNA diya gaya ho. Kitab ke mutabiq duniya mein ugayi jane wali canola, kapas (cotton), makai (corn), soybean aur chukandar (sugar beet) ka taqreeban 90% transgenic hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har transgenic jandar GMO hai, lekin har GMO transgenic nahin: agar jandar ke apne gene ko hi badla ya nikala jaye to woh GMO hai magar transgenic nahin. 90% ki itni bari shareh kuch mulkon (jaise United States) ke liye batayi jati hai; poori duniya mein in mein se kai faslon ki shareh is se kam hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya har GMO transgenic hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Nahin. Jis jandar ka genome badla gaya ho woh GMO hai; transgenic sirf tab kehlata hai jab use kisi mukhtalif, ghair mutaliq species ka DNA mila ho.

items: GMO: plant, animal ya microbe jis ka genome badla gaya ho.
Transgenic: GMO jise kisi doosri, ghair mutaliq species ka DNA mila ho.
